versions.changelog:
douyin-to-obsidian v1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Extract Douyin (TikTok China) video transcripts and convert to structured Obsidian markdown notes in one click.
- Supports bypassing Douyin anti-bot measures and local Whisper AI speech recognition.
- Handles both short links and share codes; supports long video segmentation.
- Includes automatic FFmpeg download; no manual setup needed.
- Outputs notes with YAML frontmatter, ready for Obsidian.
- Designed for easy installation and use on Windows.
